routeEvidence.detail: SafeRoute named SafetySettings mounts the lazy vehicle-systems page; /settings/safety is a different page and excluded.

purpose: Read reported vehicle driver-assistance configuration, independent security/occupant state, distance counters and recorded configuration history. Despite its name, this is not an editable settings form.
primaryGoal: Understand which of nine reported settings are enabled, disabled or unknown, inspect four security/occupant signals, and review historical changes without implying verified intervention or a driving safety rating.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed ['safety', vehicleId]; enabled only with a vehicle; STANDARD polling; forwards AbortSignal. Handler returns available mapped live values verbatim, not a timestamped SafetySnapshot object.
dataSources.units: Counter fields keep historical miles_* names, but handler performs no conversion and reads signal values directly. Their actual upstream SI guarantees were not inspected; do not infer miles from identifiers or add a compensating conversion.

routeEvidence.detail: List is registered as / within the /safety group; hook uses the group path without terminal slash. Redirect behavior was not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed ['safety', 'history', vehicleId]; enabled only with a vehicle; safeArray selection; forwards AbortSignal. Backend defaults to seven days, accepts ParseDateRange, forward-folds states, creates per-response row IDs and created_at from timeline ts.

dataSources.sourceOwner: internal\api\router.go:1011 instantiates SecurityHandler with stateReader/liveStateReader; handler internals not inspected
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed ['security-latest', vehicleId]; gated vehicleId > 0; 15-second polling; forwards AbortSignal. Page displays ts and nullable belt, occupancy and lock booleans independently of configuration.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect useVehicles query; endpoint definition not inspected in this bounded audit
dataSources.sourceOwner: Shared selected-vehicle hook/store and workspace shell
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, valid stored selection and first fleet vehicle determine the effective selection. Page does not add a competing picker. /safety-settings is vehicle-enabled but not range-enabled in workspaceScope.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Forwards PageContainer props, retains shell-owned title/actions/source trust and full-width min-w-0 container; no new layout engine.

components.name: LayoutCard / CardGrid
components.contract: Named persistent cards with semantic headings and container-based placements; description help retains full text. SafetyPanelGrid composes two source-independent panels.

components.name: VehicleSourceContent / SourceContent
components.contract: Only fatal errors replace children; retained refresh failures/paused work show source-specific warning and retry without hiding usable data. Caller owns prerequisite/loading/empty content.

components.name: VehicleOperationalBrief
components.contract: Uses existing OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics, explicit raw metrics, source period/provenance and unknown/retained state. Shared renderer/metric bridge internals not inspected.

components.name: SignalCard / SafetyCard
components.contract: Local renderers reuse KVList/Badge and LayoutCard; preserve four signal identities and all nine feature definitions.

components.name: LinearGauge / EmbeddedChart
components.contract: Gauge has semantic tone and count/scale accessibility contracts. EmbeddedChart forwards children to canonical ChartContainer with persistent chartKey; chart controller internals uninspected.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Existing pagination, persisted tableId, value filters, optional controlled sorting and optional mobilePresentation. No replacement table pipeline.

components.name: Typography / feedback / motion
components.contract: Page uses Text/Caption/PanelTitle, Button/Icon, Skeleton/EmptyState/QueryError, FadeIn, TimeStamp/DataFreshnessAuto. Their full implementation behavior was not audited.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Repeated vehicle/loading/fatal/empty branches across seven persistent panels. VehicleSourceContent already centralizes retained/fatal trust; do not introduce a parallel universal state wrapper.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing SourceContent loadingContent/emptyContent only where it preserves source-local prerequisite copy and geometry. Keep specialized content when equivalence is unproved.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Enabled-feature share and nine-setting counts appear both in the summary and in a second gauge/badge panel. This is existing functionality, not authorization to remove either.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain both presentations but reduce duplicate heading/semantic emphasis and distinguish count detail from the summary using existing layout/typography.

strengths: SafetyPanelGrid delegates measured-width packing to CardGrid.
Feature and signal grids use container-query reflow; refresh and FSD link have 44px minimum height.
History chart has bounded responsive heights.

issues.detail: History mobileColumns exposes only time, AEB and FCW. DataTable.tsx:725 hides all seven other columns below md; this caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expanded detail. Source shows mobile users lose BSC, BSCW, LDA, CFD, SLW, ELDA and PIN states, also weakening the chart's stated accessible-table alternative for BSCW/ELDA.
issues.fix: Use DataTable's existing opt-in mobilePresentation with three summary fields and all ten columns reachable in detail, or preserve full columns in a bounded table scroller. Retain filtering, pagination, ordering and tableId.

accessibility.status: keyboard, screen reader, composed contrast, forced colors, long labels and reduced-motion behavior unverified
strengths: Refresh has a localized aria-label, aria-busy and minimum 44px target.
Sections/card headings carry names; SignalCard's decorative icon span is aria-hidden.
Gauge has shared meter semantics; unknown share uses a status text instead of a false numeric zero.
History chart supplies localized title/name/description and uses step states, null gaps and disabled line animation.
FSD link has visible focus-ring classes.
accessibility.relatedFinding: responsive.issues[0]: the mobile table hides two plotted state series and therefore also compromises the chart's accessible-table alternative. Resolve once through the existing table pipeline; do not build a second chart/table alternative.

states.initialLoading: Independent geometry: five KPI skeletons, gauge skeleton, four security tiles, six feature placeholders, two counter placeholders, chart and table blocks. Six placeholders precede nine feature cards; geometry match is not runtime verified.
states.empty: Vehicle prerequisite supplies /vehicles navigation in every relevant panel; latest absence and empty history have localized explanations. Security null renders four unknown em-dash tiles, not false/unlocked/zero.
states.error: Each source uses deriveDataState/VehicleSourceContent; fatal failure replaces only its content and exposes retry. Neighboring source panels persist.
states.retained: Refresh errors and paused refresh preserve payloads with warning/retry; operational briefs label retained evidence.
states.unknownPartial: Boolean/enum absence is counted separately; enabled percentage is null if any setting is unknown. Individual features and distance counters remain visible. Explicit DataState partial coverage is not configured.
states.offlineStale: Paused work is treated as retained. No age threshold is passed to deriveDataState; timestamp widgets are present but source observation time may be missing.

issues.detail: Both snapshot briefs and the summary footer read latest.created_at, but SafetyHandler.Latest:100-107 returns only mapped settings/counters and none of those mappings is created_at. The existing brief correctly falls back to 'Observation time unavailable'; query freshness must not be promoted into observed vehicle freshness.
issues.fix: Keep explicit unknown observation time and distinguish request freshness from signal observation. If verified timestamps are required, coordinate a typed source-envelope change with the backend owner; never substitute dataUpdatedAt or Date.now as vehicle observation time.

visualIssues.detail: scoreColor supplies fixed #10b981/#f59e0b/#ef4444 and scoreBadgeVariant judges configuration share as success/warning/danger at 80/50%. These are page-defined thresholds without demonstrated safety meaning; LinearGauge already supports theme-resolved tone. No neon classes were found.
visualIssues.fix: Present the reported count/share with restrained neutral or existing theme tone, preserving all raw values and unknown handling. Do not imply safety/health quality from configuration share; do not reset saved theme or chart colors.

visualIssues.detail: PanelTitle still says 'Safety score', and subtitle at 484 repeats that phrase, even though neighboring explanation correctly says the value is a configuration count, not a driving safety rating. The inconsistent prominent language competes with the disclaimer.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the existing localized enabled-share/configuration-coverage wording in prominent headings/subtitle. Keep the no-intervention disclaimer and nine-setting count semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: History is time-scoped but does not consume useRangeState, and /safety-settings is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS. useSafetyHistory sends vehicle_id only. SafetyHandler.List:55-62 supports date input and silently defaults to seven days, while the page calls the table 'full history'.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate route registration and typed history-hook range parameters with shared/integration owners; page consumes startInstant/endInstantExclusive from the one header View settings owner, passing both bounds to server history and chart. Until integrated, label the returned seven-day/default window accurately without inventing a local date picker.

architectureIssues.detail: Time column declares sortable:true, but the DataTable call at 943-952 supplies no onSort/sortKey/sortDir. DataTable.tsx:1556 only renders a sorting button when onSort exists; the page always pre-sorts descending.
architectureIssues.fix: Either wire existing controlled sorting to a created_at accessor while retaining default descending order, or explicitly present fixed newest-first ordering rather than advertising sorting capability. Do not change source row timestamps/order accidentally.

architectureIssues.detail: Only On/Off enum strings are localized; other cleanSafetyEnum outputs are returned verbatim in feature cards and table cells (315-319), such as stripped vendor enum suffixes. Source identities must survive, but display localization is incomplete.
architectureIssues.fix: Use a bounded display-only label map for known values with localized labels and preserve raw unknown values as fallback. Do not recase wire values, change classifiers or introduce another catalog.

architectureIssues.detail: Distance counters named miles_since_reset/self_driving_miles_since_reset go directly through useUnits.formatDistance, whose lib formatter explicitly expects SI meters. Safety handler maps signal values verbatim. This is a verification dependency, NOT a proven unit-conversion defect: upstream normalization metadata was not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Before any counter/unit modification, verify the authoritative SI source metadata and preserve existing raw payload/cache values. If names misrepresent proven SI, coordinate the canonical API/type rename as one owned cutover, not a page-local multiply/divide adapter.

first: Restore complete mobile history accessibility using the existing table pipeline.
Remove safety-rating implications from configuration coverage while preserving counts.
next: Integrate shared history date bounds and accurate period labels.
Clarify sorting capability and localize known enum display labels.
priority.verificationDependency: Counter unit provenance must be confirmed before changing unit fields or formatter inputs.

requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: No shared API change proved; page adoption required.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Register /safety-settings for header range; extend useSafetyHistory with typed start/end instants in query key and snake_case request parameters accepted by existing ParseDateRange. Preserve enablement, signal cancellation, safeArray, history provenance, retry and rolling/custom/timezone semantics.
dependsOn: Verify ParseDateRange accepted parameter names and bound semantics
Coordinate other useSafetyHistory consumers without rebuilding unrelated inventory

requiredSharedChanges.name: Configuration observation-time contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: If a trustworthy observation timestamp can be obtained, specify its meaning and optional field in one typed source envelope. Retain unknown time for absent/mixed-age signals; never equate HTTP fetch time with vehicle observation.
dependsOn: Source owner establishes timestamp availability and mixed-signal freshness semantics
requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Optional integration improvement, not a blocker to honest unknown-time display; no invented capability.

competingImplementations.detail: No alternative theme, table, chart, overlay, date picker or vehicle selector is introduced by this page. SafetyPanelGrid, VehicleSourceContent and VehicleOperationalBrief compose current owners. Local hex/score thresholds compete with existing gauge tone semantics; this is captured in visualIssues, not a request for a new shared component.
competingImplementations.scopeLimit: Other pages and independent consumers were not semantically audited.

preservation.tagCountExplanation: The eighth LayoutCard source tag is the SafetyCard renderer invoked for nine features; source counts are not mounted counts. GlassPanel/ChartContainer zero does not mean sections are absent.
actions: Go to vehicles when no selection
History pagination and persisted table presentation
Shared chart hidden-series control, subject to controller runtime verification
dataBehavior: Global selected vehicle scopes every source; no local picker or settings mutation.
Nine features include inverted automatic_emergency_braking_off logic and four unknown-safe enum classifiers.
Missing fields stay unknown, not disabled or zero; percentage is unavailable if any setting is unknown.
Counter raw values remain untouched and display passes through saved useUnits/number precision.
Chart sorts chronological, preserves nullable AEB/BSCW/ELDA values, uses stepAfter and connectNulls=false.
Table keeps descending source timestamps and ten complete columns; stable tableId vehicle-systems:safety-history and chartKey safety-states-history survive.
Retained refresh payloads remain usable; sources fail independently.
History is returned forward-folded configuration, not interventions or full lifetime coverage.
Read-only reported configuration disclaimers and specialist feature descriptions survive.
